short_description: You are a detective who wants to investigate how all the inhabitants of a city died due to a virus. It all started in a hotel that was abandoned along with the city, and it was rumored to be haunted. You are on a quest for answers.
steam_languages: English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Hungarian, Japanese, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean*languages with full audio support
